policy: One candidate per asset; inspect first batch before continuing. No material increase without user approval. Originals remain unchanged.
style: One standalone native 2D pixel-art interior furnishing for On My Way to Home, lunar research habitat. Strict 2:1 diamond isometric view, top and two sides visible, ground axes down-right and down-left. Cool white/light gray aerospace casing, charcoal navy one-pixel outlines, muted slate blue, tiny restrained cyan indicators. Match existing NASA-inspired habitat and 55-pixel-tall astronaut: furniture tabletop about 25 pixels above ground, full-height equipment about 48 pixels. Flat clustered pixel shading, upper-left light. Crisp native pixels, binary transparent background, whole object with padding. No floor, room, characters, scenery, text, numbers, logo, glow, gradient, blur or watermark. Fictional lunar adaptation without scientific performance claims.

assets.brief: One compact single-occupant sleeping bunk, long white support frame with blue quilted sleeping bag and straps, pillow, enclosed head-end locker. Complete object about 80 pixels wide, ground base about 76x38 pixels. No person.

One compact packaged-food preparation counter, sealed meal drawers below, small blue-gray water nozzle and closed food compartments above, a clear 25-pixel-high worktop. Complete object about 76 pixels wide, no stove or conventional kitchen.

One compact water-efficient spacecraft hygiene and waste station: white sealed toilet seat with lid, blue-gray waste compartment, small hand-cleaning dispenser and short side control housing. Complete unit 46 pixels wide and 52 pixels tall. No tiled bathroom or open wastewater.

One practical rectangular habitat work/dining table on two sturdy gray pedestals, white metal top about 70 pixels wide, one small sealed meal pouch and mug on top. Tabletop 25 pixels above feet. No seating attached.

One small practical white/gray astronaut work chair with blue padded seat and short back, four fixed feet and handholds, no wheels. Seat 18 pixels above feet, object about 30 pixels wide and 38 pixels high.

One white EVA service rack with EMPTY folded suit cover, separate round helmet on upper shelf, dust cleaning hose, sealed tool drawers and handholds. No humanoid silhouette, no mannequin, no character. Complete rack about 72 pixels wide and 55 pixels tall.

One compact medical examination couch with blue-gray padded surface, short white supports, attached small diagnostic screen and sealed first-aid drawer with simple cyan cross. Complete object about 78 pixels wide and 48 pixels tall. No patient, no hospital scenery.

One sealed lunar sample preparation bench, pale metal worktop at 25 pixels height, two small closed sample jars, compact instrument hood and dark observation window, lower storage drawers. Complete unit about 76 pixels wide and 52 pixels tall. No magical effects.

One compact spacecraft maintenance workbench, white metal tabletop at 25 pixels height, blue tool drawers, small vise and two simple hand tools, sealed parts bins. Complete unit about 76 pixels wide and 46 pixels tall.

One low aerospace storage rack, two shelves filled with restrained white cargo boxes and small blue sealed containers. Pale gray frame, blue side braces, complete rack about 72 pixels wide and 48 pixels tall. No labels.
